description: This file defines the SkillGenerator type and associated methods responsible for generating Python skill files based on MCP server capabilities. It includes functions for creating skill files, parsing JSON schemas for MCP tools, generating function code and docstrings, and handling file operations.

classes.name: SkillGenerator
classes.description: Handles the creation of Python skill files from MCP tools, including generating function code, docstrings, and managing file operations.

classes.name: SkillFunction
classes.description: Represents a Python function wrapping an MCP tool, including its name, description, parameters, and associated docstring.

classes.name: SkillParameter
classes.description: Describes a parameter of a skill function, including its name, type, default value, and description.

methods.name: NewSkillGenerator
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SkillGenerator with specified project directory and verbosity setting.

methods.name: GenerateSkillsForServer
methods.description: Generates a Python skill file for a specific MCP server based on its capabilities.

methods.name: GenerateSkillsForAllServers
methods.description: Discovers all MCP capabilities and generates skill files for each server.

methods.name: RemoveSkillsForServer
methods.description: Removes the generated skill file for a given MCP server.

methods.name: generateSkillFileContent
methods.description: Creates the content of the Python skill file based on server capabilities, tools, and a template.

methods.name: generateSkillFunction
methods.description: Generates a Python function wrapping an MCP tool, including parameters, function name, and docstring.

methods.name: generateFunctionName
methods.description: Produces a valid Python function name based on server alias and tool name.

methods.name: parseInputSchema
methods.description: Parses a JSON schema to extract function parameters.

methods.name: mapJSONTypeToPython
methods.description: Maps JSON schema types to Python types.

methods.name: formatDefaultValue
methods.description: Formats default values for embedding into Python code.

methods.name: escapeForPython
methods.description: Escapes strings for safe inclusion in Python code.

methods.name: escapeForDocstring
methods.description: Escapes strings for safe inclusion in Python docstrings.

methods.name: generateDocString
methods.description: Creates a Python docstring for a skill function, including parameters and descriptions.
